messages:
erin: Quick postmortem follow-up thread  need to lock owners, backups, and short timelines for the span-loss + aggregation drift + ETL-lag items. I'll seed a concise plan, edit inline.

alex: I'll own span extractor backpressure. Quick mitigation = JVM bump + pin GC flags + bump consumer threads. Full fix = tokenized backpressure + safer batching.

maria: Aggregator duplicate-counts are from retries replaying same batch. Plan = dedupe by (trace,span,batch) + add `agg.dedupe.hits` metric + small sliding cache.

sam: ETL staging lag was a partition rollout + broker stall combo. Reverted rollout, instrumenting `etl.partition.idle_seconds` and adding `etl.lag_95` alert.

erin: Owners & short timelines I propose: A) span extractor mitigation -> alex -> mitigation to staging today, canary tomorrow, full redesign by 2026-04-09; B) aggregator dedupe -> maria -> PR in 3d, canary next week; C) ETL tuning -> sam -> configs in 48h.

rick: I can be backup for A while alex is on-call. Also suggest we add a canary validation that asserts no KV-span loss during promotions.

alex: Deploying JVM bump to staging now. infra-bot will log the deploy.

infra-bot: deploy started by alex at 1836001180  span-extractor/jvm-bump -> staging

alex: Early staging signals: consumer lag down ~35%, GC pause tail reduced. Monitoring `span.kv.misses` and `gc.pause_ms`.

maria: I'll add `agg.dedupe.replays` and `agg.dedupe.hits` in the PR. Tests will assert counts are idempotent on replays.

erin: Two systemic items: 1) add GC-pause regression to chaos-suite (simulate short pause and assert span coverage) -> owner: maria -> ETA 2w; 2) weekly observability digest tile for `agg.dedupe.hits`, `span.kv.misses`, `etl.lag_95` -> owner: erin -> ETA 1w.

sam: Runbook note added for emergency partition reassign. Will surface a dashboard tile for partition idle seconds.

ealex: Recurring pattern note: similar GC->span-loss occurred in Jan + Feb. Recommend a postmortem tracker of recurrence and a test that runs weekly in CI.

erin: Customer comms: draft blurb for support: "We've identified and mitigated causes of recent span loss and aggregation drift. Mitigations deployed; fixes rolling. Expect restored metric accuracy within 48 hours." Approve?

maria: LGTM.

sam: Fine by me.

erin: Locking owners in the postmortem doc and scheduling daily 15m check-ins at 09:15 PST for 3 days. If anyone is blocked, DM me. Thanks all :thumbsup:
